cli.desktop.now_listed: The app now shows up in the system's program list.
cli.desktop.was_absent: it was not in the menu.
cli.dns.no_zones: no zones in this account (does the token have Zone:Read permission?)
cli.dns.paste_token: Paste the Cloudflare API token (it will not appear on screen).
cli.dns.token_perms: Required permissions: Zone:Read and DNS:Edit for the zones you will manage.
cli.dns.token_present: Cloudflare token: kept in the vault
cli.mcp.hint_hooks: hint: `schematize vps hooks --on` closes the wrong door (raw ssh) while this one opens the right one.
cli.mcp.next_session: the tools become available to the agent in the NEXT Claude Code session:
cli.mcp.run_install: run `schematize mcp install` (or `--dry-run` to just see what would change).
cli.mcp.was_absent: the server was not registered in {path}
cli.mcp.would_allow: and would allow in permissions.allow of settings.json:
cli.panel.dns: DNS       : Cloudflare token — use `deployer dns auth --status`
cli.panel.keys_hint:
generate one: deployer ssh gen <name>
              or adopt the one you have: deployer ssh import <file>
cli.panel.not_in_menu:
(this app is not in your application menu yet:
   `deployer desktop --install` puts the icon there)
cli.panel.subtitle: SSH, VPS and DNS — with the credential out of the agent's reach.
cli.panel.title: schematize Deployer {version}
cli.panel.what_you_can_do:
WHAT YOU CAN DO
  deployer ssh list          managed keys
  deployer vps list          registered servers
  deployer dns zones         domains on Cloudflare
  deployer --help            everything
cli.ssh.test_access: test the access: schematize ssh run {name} {target} -- 'echo ok'
cli.vault.absent: vault: does not exist yet (create it with `deployer vault init`)
cli.vault.kdf_weak: NOTE: memory cost below the current standard ({standard}KiB). `change-passphrase` rewrites it with the new cost.
cli.vault.keep_passphrase:
Keep that passphrase. There is NO recovery: it is not stored anywhere —
it is what derives the key, and without it the contents are noise.
cli.vault.no_tty:
warning: no terminal — reading the passphrase from stdin.
         Through a pipe it may end up in the shell history and in `ps`.
         In a real terminal this command neither echoes nor records anything.
cli.vault.passphrase_changed: passphrase changed. The contents are the same.
cli.vps.can_level_up: you can level up: `schematize vps bootstrap {alias}`
cli.vps.fingerprint_changed:
WARNING: the fingerprint CHANGED from the pinned one:
{current}
cli.vps.fingerprint_changed_why: either the server was reinstalled, or you are not talking to it.
cli.vps.hint_opsverbs: hint: `schematize vps policy {alias} --modo opsverbs` makes the client speak the same vocabulary.
cli.vps.hook_off: hook off. The agent can run `ssh` directly again, with no audit trail.
cli.vps.hook_on:
hook on: raw SSH and reading a private key are now blocked in the agent.
remote access becomes `schematize vps exec <alias> -- <command>`.
cli.vps.mode_set: mode: {mode} (the most restrictive; adjust with `schematize vps policy {alias} --modo livre`)
cli.vps.never_probed: {count} host(s) never probed — `schematize vps probe <alias>` says what each one can take.
cli.vps.next_trust: next step: `schematize vps trust {alias}` — trust the host key before connecting
cli.vps.no_forced_command:
note: this grants key access WITHOUT a forced command. To install the boundary,
      run `schematize vps bootstrap {alias}` — it finds the level this host can take.
cli.vps.no_hosts: no host registered. Use `schematize vps add <alias> --host <ip> --user <user> --key <key>`
cli.vps.pinned_ready: host key pinned. `schematize vps exec {alias} -- <command>` works now.
cli.vps.prod_confirms: (production: every run will ask for human confirmation)
cli.vps.push_catalog: run `schematize vps bootstrap {alias}` to push the catalogue to the host.
cli.vps.removed: host {alias} removed. Its audit trail stays in `schematize vps logs {plain}`.
cli.vps.unchanged_untrusted: nothing changed — the host remains untrusted.
cli.vps.verbs_seeded: {count} verb(s) created from the suggested catalogue (nothing existing was overwritten).
gui.ssh_empty: No key in ~/.ssh — generate one above.
gui.ssh_import_hint: Point to the PRIVATE key (not the .pub). It is copied into ~/.ssh with mode 600 and keeps the passphrase it already had.
gui.ssh_priv_note: The private key is never exposed — only the public one leaves.
lang.restart_gui: reopen the GUI to apply the language everywhere.
ssh.agent_fail: could not add to the ssh-agent (is it running?).
ssh.copied: public key copied to the clipboard.
ssh.copy_fail: could not copy (install wl-copy or xclip).
ssh.paste_hint: When you are done, press Ctrl-D on an empty line.
ssh.paste_prompt: Paste the PRIVATE key below (it is never echoed).
